calculation.description: Contrarian score that fades unusually large short-term volatility moves, using lagged close returns and realized volatility. Higher scores favor assets with negative directional shocks accompanied by volatility surges.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (+0.049561, ICIR +0.142332), 2023-2024 (+0.036249, +0.104045), and 2025-2027 (+0.025911, +0.077320), but late ICIR is below the admission gate. The signal is therefore a diversified daily component requiring drift monitoring; 5-day predictive strength is below the daily gate.
